text: Nothing answers mine before an H1 buy stop. D 0.3% over the swing high is a return to the pivot, not a clearance by a margin (C19). `pipe_rank` 85.2 and `sc_momentum` 76.7 with `sc_m_gates` True hold the trend; `subcomponents.structure.rs_accel` -0.7 lead eroding. I SUPPORT the name, not this trigger. What clears my objection: close_above:high_52w_close on D, a daily close at a new 52-week closing high. Wrong if it closes back below pivot_high (C20) or reacts 1x atr_14d off the high (my translation, C7).
